title: curie adapter scaffold --json
description: The agent-facing payload of `curie adapter scaffold`: the one binding profile it wrote, the values it wrote into it, and the commands to run next. Credential IDENTITIES only, never a credential value.

file.description: Path of the binding profile that was written.

kind.description: The channel kind the scaffolded adapter owns.

address.description: The concrete address the profile was scaffolded for, and the one its generated pattern matches.

endpoint.description: The reply route written into the profile.

adapter.description: The egress credential identity the profile suggests. A suggestion only: bind requires an operator supplied slug.

next_steps.description: The commands that take this profile from authored to bound.
